articles.title: Orbex’s Subsidiary in Denmark to File for Bankruptcy
articles.summary:
Orbex’s Danish subsidiary, Orbital Express Launch ApS, is set to file for bankruptcy, with its facilities officially closing on 20 January and approximately 90 employees losing their jobs. UK-based Orbital Express Launch (Orbex) established its business in Denmark in October 2016. articles.title: Starfish Space wins SDA contract to deorbit satellites
articles.summary:
Starfish Space has won a contract from the Space Development Agency to deorbit satellites in a missile-tracking and communications constellation, evidence that deorbiting services are moving into the mainstream.

articles.title: The Exploration Company in Talks to Buy UK Rocket Builder Orbex
articles.summary:
UK-based rocket builder Orbex has signed a letter of intent to sell its business to European space logistics startup The Exploration Company. articles.title: ExLabs and ChibaTech team up to land student CubeLanders on asteroid Apophis
articles.summary:
Sydney, Australia (SPX) Jan 21, 2026


ExLabs has partnered with Japan's Chiba Institute of Technology and its Planetary Exploration Research Center to deliver university-led payloads to the surface of asteroid Apophis during its close approach to Earth in 2029. The ApophisExL mission is described as the world's first commercial deep-space rideshare and is supported through mission design and operations collaboration with NASA's Jet
